description: 2026 federal and Ontario personal income tax on a given taxable income, computed the way CRA's T4032-ON step-by-step example and T4127 formulas do it: bracket tax, minus non-refundable credits at the lowest rate (basic personal amounts plus optional extra credit amounts), Ontario surtax, Ontario Health Premium, and the Ontario basic tax reduction.
scope_exclusions: Ontario Low-income Individuals and Families Tax (LIFT) credit (on the T1 ON428, not in the payroll method)
Ontario tax reduction amounts for dependants (v0 assumes none)
federal top-up tax credit for credit amounts above the first bracket (v0 caps extra credit amounts at $10,000, far below $58,523)
dividend tax credits, alternative minimum tax, foreign tax credits, refundable credits, Quebec

citations.title: CRA, Current year tax rates and income brackets (2026)
citations.used_for: Federal 2026 brackets and rates (14%, 20.5%, 26%, 29%, 33%) and Ontario 2026 brackets and rates (5.05%, 9.15%, 11.16%, 12.16%, 13.16%).

citations.title: CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts
citations.used_for: 2026 federal basic personal amount: $16,452 maximum, $14,829 minimum, $1,623 enhanced portion; bracket thresholds cross-check.

citations.title: CRA, T4032-ON Payroll Deductions Tables, Ontario, effective January 1, 2026 (Rev. 26)
citations.used_for: Chart 1 and Chart 2 constants K and KP, Ontario BPA $12,989, Ontario surtax thresholds $5,818 and $7,446 (20% and 36%), Ontario Health Premium schedule, Ontario tax reduction basic amount $300, and the two worked examples used as fixed tests.

citations.title: CRA, T4127 Payroll Deductions Formulas, 124th edition (effective January 1, 2027), which republishes Tables 8.22 and 8.23 for 2026
citations.used_for: Shape of the federal BPA phase-out formula (linear between the 29% and 33% thresholds, division not rounded, result rounded to the cent half up), Ontario surtax and tax reduction formulas (S = lesser of T4+V1 and 2*(basic amount) - (T4+V1)), and the 2026 Table 8.22/8.23 cross-check of K, KP, ON BPA 12,989, surtax 5,818/7,446, reduction 300.

methods.bracket: Default. Tax on each bracket portion, summed, rounded to the cent. Matches the statutory rate table (Schedule 1 / ON428 style).
methods.payroll_constants: CRA payroll shortcut: rate of the top bracket reached times income, minus the whole-dollar constant K or KP. Can differ from 'bracket' by under $1. Used only to reproduce the T4032-ON worked examples exactly.

rounding: Every line is rounded to the cent, half up, before it is used in the next line, as in the T4032-ON worked examples: bracket tax, BPA after phase-out, credits (credit base times the lowest rate), surtax, health premium. Net federal tax and basic Ontario tax floor at 0.
grading_note: Plus or minus $0.10 absorbs rounding-order differences (rounding each line versus rounding once at the end shifts a result by at most a few cents). It does not absorb any wrong rate, threshold or omitted component, which moves the answer by dollars.
